children: U.S. connected operations platform's fiscal Q2 revenue rose 30%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q2 beat analyst expectations
Company cites strong growth among large customers and rising adoption of new AI features
Samsara sees Q3 revenue at $514 mln–$516 mln and full-year revenue at $2.043 bln–$2.047 bln
Company expects non-GAAP net income per share of $0.18–$0.19 for Q3 and $0.76–$0.78 for FY2027
Samsara expects to remain GAAP profitable for Q3 and full-year 2027
LARGE CUSTOMER GROWTH - Customers with ARR over $1 mln generated over $500 mln of ARR, representing over 50% year-over-year growth for the third consecutive quarter
AI FEATURE ADOPTION - Customer adoption of latest AI features is up more than 4x in the last two months, per CEO Sanjit Biswas
OPERATING LEVERAGE - Revenue growth helped expand non-GAAP operating margin and supported a fourth consecutive quarter of GAAP profitability
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 18 "strong buy" or "buy", 6 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Samsara Inc. is $44.50, about 21% above its September 2 closing price of $36.79
The stock recently traded at 45 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 48 three months ago
